# arin_roa (Resource)

A Route Origin Authorization under the provider org. Updates run as one atomic
delete+add ARIN transaction and reissue the ROA under a new handle.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `as_number` (Number) Origin AS number.
- `name` (String) Descriptive name for the ROA.
- `resources` (Attributes List) Prefixes the AS may originate. (see
  [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))

### Optional

- `auto_link` (Boolean) Create and maintain matching IRR route/route6 objects.
  ARIN does not report this back, so imported resources show the default.

### Read-Only

- `auto_renewed` (Boolean)
- `not_valid_after` (String)
- `not_valid_before` (String)
- `roa_handle` (String) Server-assigned handle. Changes on every update.

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>

### Nested Schema for `resources`

Required:

- `cidr_length` (Number) Prefix length.
- `start_address` (String) First address of the prefix.

Optional:

- `max_length` (Number) Longest prefix the AS may advertise.

Read-Only:

- `auto_linked` (Boolean)
- `end_address` (String)
- `ip_version` (Number)
